sinopsis.es: Cada día hábil, durante décadas, exactamente a las cuatro de la tarde, Pepe, un ciervo que trabaja como oficinista, se toma un café. A partir de ese momento, la implacable rutina devora su existencia.
sinopsis.en: Every working day for decades, at four in the afternoon, Pepe drinks coffee. The life of a deer clerk happens in the coffee room of his office. The routine fixed in his life. Fridays of expectations followed by disenchanted Mondays, while Pepe wins gray hair and loses enthusiasm.
